machine.description: Automated tape and reel packaging system for loading tested IC packages into carrier tape pockets, sealing anti-static cover tape, and winding completed reels for customer shipping.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Tested IC devices are picked from test trays and placed into embossed carrier tape pockets with orientation verified by vision cameras. A constant-temperature floating heat seal bar seals anti-static cover tape over carrier pockets, and finished tape is wound onto 13-inch ESD reels.
subsystems: Rotary Component Pickup & Orientation Check Vision System
Embossed Carrier Tape Indexer & Sprocket Drive
Constant-Temperature Floating Heat Seal Bar Mechanism
Cover Tape Tensioner & Dynamic Peel Force Sensor

components.name: Heat Seal Bar
components.function: Applies controlled heat and pressure to seal cover tape over carrier pockets.
components.importantParameters: Seal bar temp (°C), seal pressure (bar), dwell time (ms).
components.degradationIndicators: Temperature fluctuation (>±3°C), heater element resistance drift.

components.name: Tape Indexer Sprocket Drive
components.function: Indexes carrier tape pocket-by-pocket with high precision.
components.degradationIndicators: Indexer mechanical vibration (>0.5 mm/s), pocket pitch drift.

components.name: Cover Tape Tensioner & Peel Sensor
components.function: Maintains uniform tape tension and verifies peel strength compliance.
components.importantParameters: Tape peel force (N), tensioner spring load (N).
components.degradationIndicators: Peel force out of 0.3 - 0.7N EIA-481 spec, tape tearing.

sensors.name: Indexer Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors carrier tape indexing motor and sprocket bearing vibration.

sensors.name: Heat Seal Bar Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures continuous sealing temperature on cover tape.

sensors.name: Tape Peel Force
sensors.purpose: Measures dynamic cover tape peel strength compliance per EIA-481.

critical.description: Carrier pocket distortion and component damage

warning.description: Peel strength approaching upper specification limit

critical.description: Non-compliant seal: Customer feeder jam risk

normal.description: Monitors carrier tape indexing motor and sprocket bearing vibration.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: EIA-481 peel force between 0.3 - 0.6 N, seal blade cleaned daily

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Seal blade residue removal & thermocouple calibration
maintenance.procedureSummary: Clean brass seal blade with non-abrasive brass brush, calibrate surface pyrometer.

degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes cover tape over-sealing and peel force violation

symptoms.symptom: Cover Tape Peel Force Out of EIA-481 Spec
symptoms.recommendedAction: Calibrate seal bar temperature and inspect floating pressure springs.

failureScenarios.symptom: Cover Tape Seal Bar Temp Fluctuation & Peel Force Variance
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean brass seal blade and recalibrate temperature controller PID loop.
verificationSteps: Execute 10-meter peel force test on calibrated pull tester (0.35-0.55N verified)
Inspect pocket seal width under optical comparator
